clips.title: The story
paras: This military operation tasks Forsaken defenders with striking at the Scarlet Crusade encampment near the Balnir Farmstead in southeastern Tirisfal Glades. Under orders from Executor Zygand, players eliminate Captain Vachon and his accompanying friars to stall Crusader raids threatening the Dark Lady's domain.

As the Forsaken strive to secure the perimeter around Brill and the Undercity, the Scarlet Crusade maintains fortified pockets across the countryside. Reports funneling into town from Executor Arren alert the military command to active Crusader incursions operating out of a crumbling guard tower in southeastern Tirisfal Glades, uncomfortably close to the abandoned Balnir Farmstead.

Recognizing that disorganized zealots are far less perilous than coordinated squads, Executor Zygand focuses the offensive on their field leadership. By eliminating Captain Vachon alongside the Scarlet Friars who bolster his men with holy magic, the Forsaken aim to shatter this cell's operational cohesion and suppress human raids into nearby Forsaken territories.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We are still at war and the Scarlet Crusade grows in strength. The report Executor Arren sent me indicates Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in southeastern Tirisfal near the Balnir Farmstead under the command of Captain Vachon.
Kill Vachon along with 5 Scarlet Friars. It should prove to be a devastating blow to the Crusade!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I see you have returned but your task is not complete. Perhaps you are at ease with the mere humans interfering with The Dark Lady's plan? Or perhaps you can heed the call of duty and slay Captain Vachon and his band of Scarlet Friars!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Captain Vachon's death will slow down the Scarlet Crusade's advancement in Tirisfal quite a bit. But other threats loom.
